name: CLI batch runner
description: `afterglow run <script.jobs.json>`: ScriptRunner, which runs a versioned list of command steps over a set of input files and writes each output by name template, and Script, the format's Codable shape and validation. CL-2 stubs ScriptRunner.run (exits 69 naming CL-batch); CL-7 fills it: validate the whole script, plan every output and refuse collisions before anything runs, atomic per input, one report.
